researcher_notes:
Opus redo pass, session 4. Single leftover Toyota file in Analysed/ that was not covered by parts 1-2: '747505-040.pdf' (TP-Technical Publications Sweden, doc no. 747505-040 version 7, 2021-10-12), a VDI-2198-style Typenblatt covering the THREE Autopilot reach-truck variants RAE160 / RAE200 / RAE250 side by side. The DB holds RAE160 and RAE250 but NOT RAE200 -> classic variant-completion case, RAE200 proposed as new. All three share one chassis family (differing wheelbase, mast class and battery compartment) so a single base model with three product rows is plausible; that grouping decision is left to the importer.

PAYLOAD DERATING (recurring pattern, 4th independent instance in this redo pass) - p.4 'Lift capacities' gives an 11-row x lift-height matrix. The nameplate 'Load capacity/rated load' on p.2 row 1.5 (1600/2000/2500 kg) is NOT achievable at any lift height in that matrix: RAE160 tops out at 1470 kg even at the lowest 4850 mm mast and falls to 990 kg at 10000 mm; RAE200 1840 -> 1020 kg; RAE250 2300 -> 1650 kg. max_payload is recorded as the nameplate rating (that is what the field name and every other supplier row in the DB mean), but the derating is spelled out here and in notes because max_payload AND lifting_height are BOTH hard K.O. and AP0 cannot express their interaction.

CONFIGURATION MATRICES collapsed per the standing rule: (a) min_aisle_width - p.4 publishes an aisle-width table with two axes (4 load footprints x 2-4 battery-compartment/mast combinations, and two manoeuvre modes). The value recorded is the CONSERVATIVE (largest) figure for the standard 1200x800 Euro pallet, 'rotate on point, PPS muted' - the full per-model range is given in notes. (b) lifting_height - all three models offer the identical 11-step mast ladder 4850..10000 mm; the maximum (10000) is recorded. (c) min_total_height - p.2 row h20 'Height with navigation scanner' gives three values per model (one per mast class); the lowest is recorded since the field means 'lowest overall vehicle height'.

navigation_type deliberately left NULL: p.5 says only 'Laser precision navigation' and p.2 has rows for 'Height with navigation scanner' / 'Height eye navigation scanner'. The AP0 navigation_type mapping rule requires the words 'laser reflector' / 'reflector marker' / 'laser scanner with reflectors' before mapping to 'Laser Reflector' - 'laser precision navigation' does not meet that bar, so no value is proposed. The DB's existing 'Laser Reflector|Natural Feature (SLAM)' (RAE160) / 'Laser Reflector' (RAE250) is neither confirmed nor contradicted by this sheet.

products.notes:
CONFLICT 1 - lifting_height: DB holds 11000 mm, this sheet's maximum mast is 10000 mm (p.3). 11176 mm does appear on p.3 as row '4.5 Height, mast extended h4' - the OVERALL TRUCK HEIGHT with the mast fully raised, not the fork travel. Strong suspicion the DB value was taken from h4 rather than h23, but the sheet is v7/2021 and a newer mast may exist, so this is flagged, not corrected.
Confirmed against DB (no change): max_payload 1600, max_speed 2.0, autonomous_charging true, manual_usage true, stacking_capability true, product_type, vna_capable false.
WRONG-SCOPE value on the existing DB row: grid_required = 0 is an AMR-scope (Logistics:AGV:AMR) field sitting on a Forklift AGV row. Flag only, do not correct here.
AP0 GAP (7th instance this redo pass): p.3 row '4.35 Turning radius Rotate on point. Wa mm 1715' is an explicit, unambiguous English 'Turning radius' label on a Forklift AGV - and there is no turning-radius field in Logistics:AGV:Forklift scope. (turning_radius / min_turning_radius are Tugger and AMR scope respectively.)
Not recorded, no AP0 field: 'Energy consumption acc. to VDI cycle 3,7 kWh/h' (p.2 row 6.6), sound level 66 dB(A) (row 8.4), 'Safety of laser products Class 1 (EC 60825-1)' (p.2 footer - a laser-emission class, NOT a functional-safety PL and NOT an AP0 safety_standard value).

products.notes:
NEW PRODUCT - variant completion. The DB holds RAE160 and RAE250 from this same three-column datasheet but skipped the middle 2.0 t class. Wheelbase 1515 mm, service weight 4246 kg, drive motor 9.0 kW (p.2 rows 1.9 / 2.1 / 6.1) distinguish it physically from both siblings, so it is a genuine third machine, not a badge variant.
AP0 GAP: p.3 row '4.35 Turning radius Rotate on point. Wa mm 1845' - explicit 'Turning radius' label, no Forklift-scope field to hold it.
RAE200 is the only model offered with BOTH Triplex Hi-Lo B and C masts (p.3), which is why its aisle-width range spans two mast classes.

products.notes:
CONFLICT 1 - max_speed: DB holds 2.5 m/s; p.2 row 5.1a gives 7,2 km/h in BOTH auto and manual mode for all three models = 2.0 m/s. 2.5 m/s would be 9 km/h, which appears nowhere in the document. Flagged, not corrected.
CONFLICT 2 - lifting_height: DB holds 12000 mm; the RAE250 mast ladder on p.3 tops out at 10000 mm and even 'Height, mast extended h4' only reaches 11176 mm, so 12000 is not derivable from this sheet at all.
DIVERGENCE (not flagged as a hard conflict) - min_aisle_width: DB holds 3071 mm, which matches no cell of the p.4 RAE250 aisle table (nearest neighbours 3053 and 3078). Likely from a different source/configuration; worth a reviewer glance.
DIVERGENCE - vehicle_width: DB holds 1270 mm, which IS on this sheet but as row '4.21 Overall width b1' (chassis only). The widest point of the truck is 1570 mm over the support arms including scanners (row 4.22). Not a data error so much as a different row choice; recorded here as 1570 because the AP0 hint says the field 'drives min aisle/door clearance'.
DIVERGENCE - vehicle_length: DB holds 2755 mm; this sheet's RAE250 'Length across support arms l7' is 2091 mm and 'Length to face of forks l2' ranges 1516-1643 mm (+1200 mm fork = 2716-2843 mm overall). 2755 mm is plausible as an over-forks length for a mid-battery configuration but is not printed anywhere. Noted only.
CONFIRMED against DB: max_payload 2500, max_gradient 7.0, mast_type Triplex, drive_type Reach Truck, battery_type Lead-Acid|Li-Ion, autonomous_charging, manual_usage, stacking_capability, barcode_readers, vna_capable false.
LIKELY-WRONG existing DB value: forks_free_floating = 1 on a Reach Truck. The AP0 hint for that field states explicitly that 'straddle/reach trucks fail here', and p.2 row 4.27 confirms the load sits between two support arms. Proposed correction to false - flagged for manual resolution, not applied.
WRONG-SCOPE values on the existing DB row (flag only): route_type = 'Flexible Route', route_programming = 'Map-based' and turning_radius = 1903 are all Logistics:AGV:Tugger-scope fields, and workflow_capability = 'Transport' and grid_required = 0 are Logistics:AGV:AMR-scope fields, on a Forklift AGV row. Note the turning_radius VALUE is exactly right - p.3 row '4.35 Turning radius Rotate on point. Wa mm 1903' for RAE250 - it is only the field's scope that is wrong. That is direct evidence for the AP0 gap above: someone had a real forklift turning radius and no correct field to put it in.
Not recorded, no AP0 field: 'Energy consumption acc. to VDI cycle 5,2 kWh/h', sound level 66 dB(A), 'Safety of laser products Class 1 (EC 60825-1)'.
